name: Dutch Republic
officialName: Republic of the Seven United Netherlands
aliases: Republic of the Seven United Netherlands

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of orange, white and blue.
flag.symbolism: The colours come from the livery of William of Orange, who led the Dutch Revolt against Spanish rule; the flag is known as the Prinsenvlag, the Prince's Flag.

hook: The Prince's Flag is the Dutch flag with orange where the red is; South Africa's old flag kept the orange too but added three small flags in the middle.
trivia: During the 17th century the orange stripe gradually gave way to red, producing the red, white and blue flag of the Netherlands.
Its colours live on in places with Dutch roots: the flag of New York City is blue, white and orange.
